blocks.rationale: Create a grounded airline calculator that leaves only source-specific classification and fee-table extraction to one joint reader, while deterministically assigning checked-bag positions and applying the higher of oversize and overweight charges. This directly targets both failed airline parents and can also improve the history airline parent without encoding any case answer.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What integer ticket price is stated for the current passenger?

inputs.name: dimension_totals
inputs.question: For every current item in fact order, what is its total outside dimension in inches, calculated as length plus width plus height?

inputs.name: weights
inputs.question: For every current item in the same order, what is its weight in pounds?

inputs.name: is_free_carryon
inputs.question: For every current item in the same order, does it qualify as a permitted carry-on or personal item that is not treated as a checked bag?

inputs.name: checked_base_fee_schedule
inputs.question: For the current route, cabin, and complimentary-bag status, what are the integer base fees for the first, second, third, and fourth-or-later checked bags, in that order?

inputs.name: oversize_fee_schedule
inputs.question: For the current route, what are the integer oversize fees for bags over 62 through 65 total inches and over 65 through 115 total inches, in that order?

inputs.name: overweight_fee_schedule
inputs.question: For the current route and cabin, what are the integer overweight fees for bags over 50 through 53 pounds, over 53 through 70 pounds, and over 70 through 100 pounds, in that order?

skill.intent: Compute the exact integer ticket-plus-bag total for a current itinerary from the passenger's bags and the route-and-cabin fee schedules stated in the current source.

outputs.description: The exact integer ticket price plus all current checked-bag base fees and applicable higher-of-size-or-weight surcharges.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: ticket_price
fields.question: What is the stated integer ticket price?

fields.name: dimension_totals
fields.question: What are the aligned length-plus-width-plus-height totals for all listed items?

fields.name: weights
fields.question: What are the aligned weights in pounds for all listed items?

fields.name: is_free_carryon
fields.question: Which aligned items qualify as permitted carry-on or personal items rather than checked bags?

fields.name: checked_base_fee_schedule
fields.question: What four-position checked-bag base-fee schedule applies after route, cabin, and complimentary-bag rules?

fields.name: oversize_fee_schedule
fields.question: What two oversize-tier fees apply to the current route?

fields.name: overweight_fee_schedule
fields.question: What three overweight-tier fees apply to the current route and cabin?

reads.question: Read the current passenger, itinerary, item measurements, carry-on eligibility, complimentary allowance, and applicable route-and-cabin fee-table entries as one aligned bag-fee record.
reads.source_locator: current source bag-fee rules, facts, and question

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Determine which current items fit the source's permitted carry-on or personal-item allowance and therefore do not enter the checked-bag sequence.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

source_obligations.statement: Select the checked-bag-position, oversize, and overweight fee schedules applicable to the current route and cabin, including complimentary checked-bag entries.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For each checked bag, add its position-based fee and only the higher applicable oversize or overweight fee before adding the ticket price.

source_provenance.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

blocks.rationale: Create a narrow §1 tax-schedule classifier for the failed SARA trigger. It computes the governing bracket and statutory tax from current-source schedule arrays, so a claim citing an inapplicable subparagraph is contradicted without copying the case label or answer.

inputs.name: taxable_income
inputs.question: What taxable income is stated in the current facts?

inputs.name: claimed_tax_amount
inputs.question: What dollar tax amount does the current affirmative claim assert?

inputs.name: cited_bracket_number
inputs.question: Which numbered bracket of the current §1 filing-status schedule does the claim cite, with bracket (i) represented as 1?

inputs.name: finite_upper_bounds
inputs.question: For the current taxpayer's filing-status schedule, what are the finite taxable-income upper bounds in ascending bracket order, excluding the final unbounded bracket?

inputs.name: bracket_base_amounts
inputs.question: For every bracket of the current filing-status schedule, what statutory base tax amount applies before the marginal excess calculation, using zero for the first bracket?

inputs.name: bracket_rates
inputs.question: For every bracket of the current filing-status schedule, what marginal rate applies as a decimal number?

skill.intent: Classify an affirmative claim about tax owed under a cited §1 bracket by selecting the applicable bracket and calculating the statutory amount from the current filing-status schedule.

outputs.description: The native binary classification label: Entailment or Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: taxable_income
fields.question: What is the current taxpayer's taxable income?

fields.name: claimed_tax_amount
fields.question: What tax amount is asserted by the current claim?

fields.name: cited_bracket_number
fields.question: What one-based bracket number is cited by the current claim?

fields.name: finite_upper_bounds
fields.question: What are the finite upper bounds for the filing-status schedule applicable to the current taxpayer?

fields.name: bracket_base_amounts
fields.question: What aligned base tax amounts are stated for all brackets of that schedule?

fields.name: bracket_rates
fields.question: What aligned decimal marginal rates are stated for all brackets of that schedule?

reads.question: Read the current taxpayer's filing status, taxable income, claimed amount and cited bracket together with the corresponding §1 bracket schedule.
reads.source_locator: current source §1 tax schedule, referenced definitions, facts, and question

origin.quote: There is hereby imposed on the taxable income of every married individual (as defined in section 7703) who does not make a single return jointly with his spouse, a tax determined in accordance with the following:

source_obligations.statement: Use the filing status established by the current facts and referenced definitions to select the corresponding §1 schedule.

source_obligations.statement: Determine the applicable bracket from taxable income, compute its stated base-plus-marginal tax, and require both the cited bracket and claimed amount to match.
